build_lora_a_ptr: build LoRA A pointer metadata from a list of weight tensors and a CUDA device for Triton grouped GEMM
build_lora_b_ptr: build LoRA B pointer metadata with slice offsets, strides, and hidden sizes for Triton grouped GEMM
run_lora_op_configs: run LoRA kernel config lookup by operation type, batch size, hidden size, rank, and number of slices
test_supports_pdl: test whether the current CUDA device supports programmatic dependent launch (PDL) with SM90+
test_supports_tma: test whether the current CUDA device supports tensor memory aliasing (TMA) with SM90+
